formulas.total_operating_expenses: compensation_and_benefits + repairs_and_maintenance + depreciation_and_amortization + purchased_transportation + fuel + other_occupancy + other_expenses

revenue_yoy.description: Total revenue YoY growth rate vs Q4-2024

compensation_and_benefits_margin_delta_b.description: Compensation and benefits as % of revenue, delta vs Q4-2024

purchased_transportation_margin_delta_bp.description: Purchased transportation as % of revenue, delta vs Q4-2024

fuel_margin_delta_bps.description: Fuel expense as % of revenue, delta vs Q4-2024

depreciation_and_amortization_yoy.description: Depreciation and amortization expense YoY growth rate vs Q4-2024

repairs_and_maintenance_yoy.description: repairs_and_maintenance YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_occupancy_yoy.description: other_occupancy YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_expenses_abs.description: other_expenses absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_income_expense_abs.description: other_income_expense absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
